front.title: Publishing SCION Endpoint Addresses in DNS Service Binding (SVCB) Records

abstract.t: This document defines "scion", a Service Parameter Key (SvcParamKey) for the Service Binding (SVCB) and HTTPS DNS resource records. Its value lists the addresses at which a service endpoint is reachable over SCION (Scalability, Control, and Isolation On Next-generation networks), a path-aware inter-domain network architecture. This document specifies the wire format, presentation format, and semantics of the key and requests its registration with IANA.
